project.name: Dunnichen
project.boundarySource: Mapped named-place location with a conservative editorial study buffer
project.researchNotes: Full strict-boundary audit. Dunnichen remains selector-only at 40. The battle cairn and hill are separate See entries and do not transfer their appeal to the settlement score. Visit Angus marks both map pins as guide locations, so no parking card is published from them. No qualifying cafe, picnic site or public toilet was verified. The official 41 km cycle circuit is retained with its working page. All 15 local heritage records remain intact; eleven dateable records are visible and the four period-unassigned records remain map-hidden. Angus-wide full audit completed 2026-09-01: all six visitor categories, the four named commercial trail providers, current official/conventional routes, strict-boundary scoring and local HES/NRHE integrity were checked.
